answer_1.quote: Natural language generation (NLG), such as paraphrase generation , text summarization , machine translation , and language models , have shown remarkable progress in the past few years.

answer_2.quote: We use the BLEU score  to evaluate machine translation performance. For paraphrase generation, we also adopt ROUGE  and METEOR ... we report iBLEU : which evaluates the generation fidelity with novelty to the source sentence considered * .

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a human evaluation to evaluate generation quality and diversity on paraphrase generation. We ask three annotators to vote for one of the two candidates: hypotheses from the seq2seq baseline and our method.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are required to decide, which one is better by considering Fidelity, Novelty, and Diversity
